milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The wolves are placed at spawn-relative (8, 0, 8) with NoAI so they stay put. The player must navigate within 5 blocks and face the wolf's direction (facing_tolerance=60°) to demonstrate they have visually located it. This is the preferred rule for find/observe tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The pink glazed terracotta cluster is at spawn-relative (-5, 0, -5). The player must navigate within 5 blocks and face the terracotta (facing_tolerance=60°) to demonstrate visual discovery. This is the preferred rule for find/observe tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a block of redstone (9 redstone dust → 1 redstone_block at the crafting table) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 128 redstone dust and 0 redstone blocks, so having ≥1 redstone_block confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule for craft tasks.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building/furnishing a house requires placing blocks inside it. The pre-built oak frame occupies spawn-relative (10-14, 0-5, 10-14) with interior space at (11-13, 1-3, 11-13). Checking for a redstone_lamp placed within the house walls (box [10,1,10] to [14,5,14]) confirms the player has actively furnished the interior. The redstone lamp requires the previously crafted redstone_block to power it, enforcing the craft dependency. Box matches the actual house structure boundaries exactly.
